title: Hickory DNS 0.24.0 before 0.26.2 Denial of Service via Zone File Parser
description: CVE-2026-123574 is a denial of service vulnerability in Hickory DNS versions 0.24.0 through before 0.26.2 caused by issues in the zone file parser. The flaw allows an attacker to cause service disruption by exploiting improper input validation. No CVSS score or detailed impact metrics are provided. No patch or remediation information is available in the provided data.
